project_info.theme: Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra ultra sleek design and S Pen poster
project_info.color_palette: Black, white, silver, graphite gray, soft pink screen glow

main_subject.detail: Black-background product poster comparing silver and gray Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra color variants with a white next-gen S Pen, emphasizing ultra-sleek industrial design.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic premium hardware render, high-contrast minimal launch infographic

composition_elements.text: Ultra sleek design. Equipped with a next-gen S Pen / Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra / Silver / Gray
items: Top Left: Large centered white headline 'Ultra sleek design. Equipped with a next-gen S Pen'.
Top Right: Smaller centered subtitle 'Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra'.
Bottom Left: Silver color dot label 'Silver' above the silver tablet rear-view crop.
Bottom Right: Gray color dot label 'Gray' above the gray tablet stack and vertical white S Pen at far right.
Center/Background: Cropped oversized tablet hardware close-ups across the bottom half, including silver rear view, gray rear/front stack with pink display, and a standalone white S Pen.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Sharp metallic highlights, deep black contrast, clean hardware gloss on camera rings

Background is deep black with premium contrast. Surrounding elements: exact title 'Ultra sleek design. Equipped with a next-gen S Pen', subtitle 'Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra', and two color labels 'Silver' and 'Gray'. Technical style: photorealistic product render, studio lighting, sharp metallic highlights and glossy camera-ring detail, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
